dates.text: tertio so julii anno a nativitate Domini millesimo quadringentesimo quadra gesioprimo

data.summary: The Pope grants a petition from Amedeus Carles Laiti to relax a corporal oath he made in a sale of property, which he claims was extracted under duress and fraud by Peter Fonte Aciam Laitus and a Jew named Crois San, and orders the addressee to execute this relaxation.
